cli.usage:
{app}

  {app}.exe                 Start the tray icon
  {app}.exe --tray          Same as above
  {app}.exe --paste PATH    Paste the clipboard into PATH
  {app}.exe --paste-plain   Paste as plain text into the active window
  {app}.exe --config        Open the settings window
  {app}.exe --about         Show the About window
  {app}.exe --register      Register the context menu entry
  {app}.exe --unregister    Remove the context menu entry
